cases.name: Patricia Ruth Vaughn Dent
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Patricia was born in Long Beach, California to Curtiss and Estelle Rose Maher Vaughn. She was a chef with Mount Vintage Golf Club in North Augusta, SC and she was an outstanding cook. Patricia was a talented artist and loved her crafts. She was a friend to everyone she knew and met and would give you the “shirt off of her back” if you were in need."
cases.narrative: He died of a heart attack while burying her body in their backyard.
